APP 01 / UNSEND

Unsend

Write what you need to say. Release it privately, or choose to share it anonymously with the community.

TYPE / WRITING & WELLBEINGPLATFORM / IPHONE

A place to let words go

Unsend gives your thoughts somewhere to land before you decide what to do with them. Shred, burn, or dissolve a note privately. Public sharing is a separate choice: when you post anonymously, approved posts can be read and replied to in Explore.

Anonymous means no public name is shown. Avoid including details that could identify you or someone else. Public posting and Explore features are being prepared for an app update.

Get the app

Unsend is available for iPhone.
